name: focus-organizador-pessoal
description: FOCUS - organizador pessoal local-first, PWA e base para Android com Capacitor.

scripts.dev: npm run build:web && npx serve www -l 4173
scripts.cap:init: npx cap init FOCUS com.focus.app --web-dir www
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build:web && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:prepare: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android && python scripts/prepare_android.py
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:prepare && npm run android:debug
